bib.title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs

read.skipped: reference list skimmed; case-study passages in Tables 10-11 skimmed

question: Can one instruction-tuned LLM serve as both the context reranker and the answer generator in RAG, beating a separate expert reranker and strong RAG baselines?
hypothesis: Context ranking and answer generation are dual capabilities that mutually enhance each other when an LLM is tuned on both.
contributions: RankRAG: a two-stage instruction-tuning framework that teaches one LLM both context ranking and answer generation
A small fraction of ranking data in the blend yields ranking that beats LLMs fine-tuned with 10x more ranking data
Comparison against ChatQA-1.5, GPT-4 and others on nine general-domain and five biomedical RAG benchmarks

method.summary: Llama3 8B/70B are first supervised fine-tuned on 128K instruction examples (Stage-I), then tuned on a Stage-II blend of SFT data, context-rich QA, retrieval-augmented QA, MS MARCO plus synthetic-conversation context ranking (~50k pairs) and retrieval-augmented ranking, all cast as (question, context, answer). At inference a Dragon retriever returns top-N, the model scores each passage by P('True'), keeps top-k and generates.
method.task: open-domain QA, fact verification, conversational QA with retrieve-rerank-generate

datasets.name: Stage-I SFT blend (private crowd-sourced conversation, OpenAssistant, Dolly, SODA, ELI5, Self-Instruct, Unnatural Instructions, FLAN, CoT)
datasets.source: includes a private crowd-sourced conversational dataset
datasets.preprocessing: multi-turn format; loss only on last assistant response

datasets.name: Stage-II blend: DROP, NarrativeQA, Quoref, ROPES, NewsQA, TAT-QA, HumanAnnotatedConvQA, SyntheticConvQA, SQuAD, WebQuestions, MS MARCO, Stage-I SFT
datasets.size: ranking data ~50k pairs (MS MARCO + synthetic conversation); total blend size not stated
datasets.source: public sets plus ChatQA's open-sourced ConvQA
datasets.preprocessing: retrieval-augmented sets: gold + BM25 top contexts to 5 passages, shuffled; ranking negatives mined by BM25; conversation docs cut into 150-word chunks, 4-gram recall with the answer >0.5 relevant, <0.1 irrelevant

datasets.name: NQ, TriviaQA, HotpotQA (KILT splits), PopQA, 2WikimQA, FEVER, Doc2Dial, TopiOCQA, INSCIT
datasets.size: NQ 2837, TriviaQA 5355 (KILT); PopQA 1399 long-tail questions; others not stated
datasets.source: Dec 2018 Wikipedia dump (NQ, TQA, HotpotQA, 2Wiki), Dec 2020 dump (PopQA)
datasets.preprocessing: string-match check found no overlap with training data

datasets.name: Mirage biomedical: MMLU-med, PubMedQA, BioASQ, MedQA, MedMCQA

training.objective: instruction tuning, next-token loss on the assistant response; ranking cast as True/False or passage-index generation
training.compute: 8B 10 h on 32 A100 (4 h Stage-I, 6 h Stage-II); 70B 16 h on 128 A100 (4 h + 12 h)

other.stage_II_blend_ratios: Drop .069, narrativeqa .09, quoref .026, ropes .026, SQuAD RQA .09, SQuAD RAR .02, WebQ RQA .09, WebQ RAR .02, newsqa .09, tatqa-arithmetic .15, tatqa-others .08, ConvQA .2, MS MARCO ranking .15, ConvQA ranking .03, SFT .2, normalised to 1 (App B)

inference.samples: inferred: one run per item, no seeds or variance reported
inference.prompting: zero-shot, system prompt plus top-k reranked passages, 'Answer the above question with a short phrase.'
inference.retrieval: Dragon top-N (100 for 8B, 30 for 70B), reranked by P('True'), top-k in {5,10,20} with best reported for baselines

metrics.name: Recall@k
metrics.definition: answer recall in top-k passages after ranking

eval.protocol: zero-shot; baseline k chosen as best of 5/10/20; GPT rerankers use True token logprob; no significance test or seeds stated

availability.data: inferred: the Stage-I blend contains a private crowd-sourced conversation set not released

prompts.text: For the question <question>, access whether the passage is relevant to the question. Return True if relevant, otherwise False.
For the question <question>, access whether the above passages are relevant to the question. Return all the relevant passage id.

This is a chat between a user and an artificial intelligence assistant. The assistant gives helpful, detailed, and polite answers to the user's questions based on the context. The assistant should also indicate when the answer cannot be found in the context.

evidence.quote: we reduce the learning rate to 3e-7 for 8B and 2e-7 for 70B model, set the batch size to 64, and train the model for 3300 steps (around 1 epoch)

limits: Single-time retrieval only; multi-round RAG left as future work (Sec 5.2)
Reranking adds latency; measured 0.9x to 6.0x for N=20 to 100 on Llama3-8B only
BGE-Rerank was trained on NQ, TriviaQA and HotpotQA and on ~1.6M pairs, so the comparison is not data-matched
Stage-I data includes a private crowd-sourced set; no code or weights stated
No seeds, variance or significance tests; baseline k tuned per baseline on test sets
GPT-4 RAG numbers drop partly because of refusals (Table 2 footnote); NQ/TriviaQA use KILT subsets, DPR-split results in Table 9
